d1.title: Chest · Shoulders · Triceps · Abs

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press · 8–10
exercises.detail: 5 sec down, 1 sec up. Last set to failure. Rest 90 sec.

exercises.name: Incline floor press · 10–12
exercises.detail: Torso propped on the ottoman at 30–45°. Upper chest. 3 sec down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor fly · 12–15
exercises.detail: Slow. Pause 2 sec in the stretch.

exercises.name: Slow push-ups · near failure
exercises.detail: 3 sec down, pause at the bottom. Grip the dumbbell handles to keep wrists neutral.

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead press · 10–12
exercises.detail: Seated on the ottoman. Slow down, full lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise · 12–15
exercises.detail: Strict. On the last set, finish with half reps until you can't lift.

exercises.name: Overhead tricep extension · 10–12
exercises.detail: Both hands on one dumbbell. Deep stretch, slow down.

exercises.name: Tricep kickbacks · 12–15
exercises.detail: Hinge forward, elbow pinned high. Squeeze 1 sec at the top.

exercises.name: Diamond push-ups · to failure
exercises.detail: Finisher.

exercises.name: Weighted crunches · 15
exercises.detail: Dumbbell on chest. Slow.

exercises.name: Lying leg raises · 15
exercises.detail: Legs straight. Lower slow, don't let your back arch.

d1.cardio: Optional 15–20 min hill climb later in the day.

d2.title: Back · Biceps · Posture · Abs

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row · 12–15 each side
exercises.detail: Hand and knee on the ottoman. 3 sec down, pause 1 sec at the top.

exercises.name: Bent-over two-arm row · 12–15
exercises.detail: Hinge at the hips, back flat, pull to the ribs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover · 12
exercises.detail: Across the ottoman. Both hands on one dumbbell. Big stretch for the lats.

exercises.name: Reverse fly · 15
exercises.detail: Bent over, arms out like wings. Rear delts. Light and strict.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrug · 15
exercises.detail: Hold 2 sec at the top. Traps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl · 10–12
exercises.detail: 3 sec down. No swinging.

exercises.name: Hammer curl · 10–12
exercises.detail: Palms facing in. Brachialis and forearm.

exercises.name: Concentration curl · 10 each side
exercises.detail: Elbow braced on the inner thigh. Squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: YTW raises (prone) · 8 each letter
exercises.detail: Face down. Arms in a Y, then T, then W.

exercises.name: Russian twist with dumbbell · 20 total
exercises.detail: Lean back, feet up if you can. Obliques.

d2.cardio: Optional 15–20 min hill climb later in the day.

d3.title: Legs · Ski Prep · Core

exercises.name: Leg swings · 10 each leg, each direction
Bulgarian split squats · 10 each side
exercises.detail: Rear foot on the ottoman, dumbbells in hand. 3 sec down.

exercises.name: Kettlebell goblet squats · 12
exercises.detail: Deep. Every rep is one and a half: down, half up, down, all the way up.

exercises.name: Wall sit · 60 sec
exercises.detail: Thighs parallel. Hold the dumbbells on your thighs when 60 sec gets easy.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift · 10 each side
exercises.detail: Dumbbell in each hand. Hinge, flat back, slow down. Hamstrings and balance.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swings · 20
exercises.detail: Hip hinge, not a squat. Explosive.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise · 15 each side
exercises.detail: On a step. Dumbbell in one hand, full stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold · 30 sec
exercises.detail: Lower back pressed into the floor.

d3.cardio: This session counts as ski conditioning. Log it as cardio too if you want.

d4.title: Chest · Back · Shoulders · Arms · Abs

exercises.name: Incline floor press · 10–12
exercises.detail: Upper chest first today. 3 sec down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press · 10–12
exercises.detail: Pause 2 sec with elbows on the floor, then drive up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell squeeze press · 12
exercises.detail: Dumbbells pressed together the whole rep. Constant tension.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl · 10–12
exercises.detail: Superset: go straight into the tricep extension, then rest 60 sec.

exercises.name: Hammer curl · 12
exercises.detail: Superset with the diamond push-ups.

d4.cardio: Max Day tomorrow. Skip extra cardio so you test fresh.

d5.title: Benchmarks · Ski Legs · Abs

exercises.name: Max consecutive pushups
exercises.detail: Standard form. Log it.

exercises.name: Max single-arm row reps (at 10 kg)
exercises.detail: Strict reps. Log it.

exercises.name: Max plank hold
exercises.detail: Time it. New PR.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squats · 12 each side
exercises.detail: Lighter and faster than Day 3. Burn, not grind.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise · 15
exercises.detail: Light and strict. Shoulder width.

exercises.name: Weighted crunches · 12
exercises.detail: Heavier and slower than Day 1.

d5.cardio: No extra cardio needed today. Rest day tomorrow.
